_readme: Per-run monitoring log, one file per calendar day (America/Phoenix), used to generate the Daily PDF Report. Distinct from cases.json, which is the permanent case/review-queue index.
_run_note: Nineteenth scheduled run, and the first with new findings since 2026-10-01. 15 of 20 URLs served a catalog; Flower Meadow Dream remains refused by this environment's egress proxy and the four marketplace and social entries have no product feed. THREE new matches, all genuinely new listings rather than names newly looked for: Rose Explosion's catalog grew 1,435->1,439 and one of the additions is 'Patchouli Rose Plant｜广藿香', matching the PENDING mark Patchouli (Jan Spek Rozen, App. Ser. No. 50051958) -- the first new Pending finding since 2026-09-21. Mola Rose and Muse Roses each added the same listing, 'Eastern Secret Realm Rose', matching the chart's unstatused 'Secret'; both are classified Possible, since 'Secret' is a single ordinary word inside a longer title and may well be a different variety. Cases ROSEEXPLOS-074, MOLAROSE-040 and MUSEROSES-040. Nothing held, nothing cut-roses-only. 371 of 375 cases re-verified; the four unconfirmed are Flower Meadow Dream's 3 and HILLSIDERO-005, absent for an eighth run.

sites.notes: Facebook page; facebook.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage, so the page was never reached. No open product feed exists for a Facebook page in any case.
Etsy storefront; etsy.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage. The seller's own site (ergongzy.com) was crawled in full and carries the same catalog.

760 products, one more than yesterday, and the new listing is a match: 'Eastern Secret Realm Rose' against the chart's unstatused 'Secret'. Case MOLAROSE-040.
760 products, one more than yesterday, carrying the same new listing as Mola Rose: 'Eastern Secret Realm Rose'. Case MUSEROSES-040.
